charts.title: Single files
charts.caption: Formatting speed on single files relative to arity, one dot per document: the largest source file of each benchmarked package, then two synthetic corpus tiers. The vertical axis is mean wall-clock time as a ratio to arity on a log scale, so arity lies on the dashed baseline at 1; faster tools fall below it and slower tools rise above. Hover a dot for the exact figures.
